hypotheses.Q0_route_templates_are_small: Every tested operator needs at most six route scalars in addition to its three head identities and source-role definition.
hypotheses.Q1_four_bit_routes_retain_function: Four-bit symmetric route coefficients reach at least 0.70 program-output fidelity in all four direct-read families.
hypotheses.Q2_two_bit_routes_often_retain_function: Two-bit symmetric route coefficients reach at least 0.70 program-output fidelity in at least three families.
hypotheses.Q3_one_bit_sign_routes_are_not_assumed_s: One-bit sign-and-mean-magnitude routes are reported as an aggressive falsification target and pass only if all four families reach 0.70 fidelity.
hypotheses.Q4_quantized_routes_preserve_float_opera: Four-bit fidelity is within 0.10 of the unquantized shared-route operator in every family.
